label: late copy-phase steps in long (L>=8) sequences
explanation: Active only in the copy phase (99% of mass); never during original input and barely at <DEL>. Fires from about the 4th recalled token (recall_idx >= 3) onward, mainly in long sequences (L=9 holds 75% of mass, L=8 20%, none for L<=5). Rate climbs steeply with absolute step t (2% at t=10, 20% at t=12, 65% at t=17), and the largest activations sit at the final one or two copy steps of L=9 sequences. Within that window it fires on only about a third of steps, sparsely and with some token preference (in_tok r, j, 2, z higher), but no token set gives a clean rule. The predicate captures 94% of mass at low precision (dev F1 0.47).
